'''''Swen''''' was a pair of [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] used by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] learned that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|New Death Star]] they began to amass their forces to strike at the station, believing it to be under construction and not fully operational. In reality, the station, although still under construction, was fully armed and operational and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] wanted to lure the entire fleet into a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]] to destroy them. A potential problem for this plan was beginning to take root when a [[Unidentified Bothan computer programmer|Bothan computer programmer]] had reviewed the data and became suspicious. Fearing that his theory would compromise Palpatine's plans, the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Empire]], informed [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] of the situation and told him that the programmer was on one of the two shuttles to meet up with a Rebel summit in the [[Delfii system/Legends|Delfii system]].

Stele arrived at the Summit in a [[Missile Boat]] to recon and inspect the summit. Flying through multiple Rebel starfighters, Stele soon intercepted and destroyed the shuttle the expert was on, silencing his theory before it could be reached to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel Command]].

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttles appear in [[LucasArts]]' Star Wars: TIE Fighter expansion pack in Battle 12 combat 6 "Recon Military Summit". The shuttle that has the cargo "Programmer" must be destroyed as a part of a secondary mission objective. The shuttle in question changes between the two.
